blind.description: A conical mound of dirt and stones in a stylized art style, featuring embedded rocks along the slopes and base, and two broken wooden beam or post stubs protruding from the mound (one near the summit and one partway down the side). The surface geometry is solid, cohesive, and grounded, with stylized textures depicting packed earth, rock facets, and weathered wood.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular mound of mixed brown earth and rocky rubble with two rectangular wooden post ends visible sticking out.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 4.5 feet in diameter.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
